acceptance_criteria.condition: A completed effect record cannot silently alter its scope, protocol, analysis gate, task plan, or stopping rule after preregistration.
Every completed task pair has the registered stratum, fixed repeat count, deterministic condition order, matching model/Harness, and blind hidden-repair outcome.
The Skill and README describe a bounded claim and prohibit treating an unrun protocol or local forward test as model-wide improvement evidence.
Historical forward-test inputs remain verifiable against the Git revision actually used rather than current mutable Skill or scorer bytes.
A read-only Causal Full diagnosis, including one with an in-memory probe, ends with the exact unknown conclusion instead of an overconfident causal-owner label.

invariants: A planned or incomplete experiment is not evidence of a Skill effect.
A completed improvement claim is limited to the preregistered model, Harness, Skill revision, corpus, and hidden scorer.
Repeated runs of one task remain one clustered task for inference.
Historical forward-test evidence is verified against the recorded input revision.
A read-only counterfactual remains an unknown causal conclusion, even when observations or an in-memory probe support a candidate owner.

safeguards.name: immutable preregistration envelope
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer rejects any completed record whose envelope hash no longer matches scope, protocol, analysis, task plan, or stopping rule.

safeguards.name: paired task-cluster inference
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer uses task-cluster bootstrap intervals and paired sign-flip randomization rather than treating repeated task attempts as independent.

safeguards.name: anti-selection and order checks
safeguards.rationale: Completed records must cover every planned task and repeat, and each pair must follow the deterministic order derived from the frozen seed.

safeguards.name: bounded reporting
safeguards.rationale: The template reports not_run without trials, and docs reserve improved only for a completed scoped experiment.

safeguards.name: fresh composite forward test
safeguards.rationale: A new protocol-isolated agent response passed 15 of 15 compound delivery checks while its manifest records the limited isolation boundary.

safeguards.name: causal-calibration terminal gate
safeguards.rationale: Fresh V5, V7, and V9 responses failed by upgrading unrun or in-memory-only evidence; the preflight gate, context-aware scorer, and fresh V10 response require explicit authority/status fields and the exact unknown terminal conclusion.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md defines the claim boundary, the analyzer owns deterministic eligibility and inference, and the reference owns procedural detail.

dependency_audit.rationale: The analyzer and tests use only the Python standard library and existing package tooling.

extension_decision.rationale: A reusable analyzer is justified because aggregate-effect claims need the same nontrivial validation and inference rules across future runs.

data_ownership.rationale: The package stores only public fixture metadata and synthetic trial schema; it owns no application or personal data.

error_model.rationale: The analyzer distinguishes malformed evidence, not_run, improved, inconclusive, and no_demonstrated_improvement; the calibration scorer rejects unrun, proposed, or read-only conclusions without the unknown terminal label.

contract_evolution.rationale: The public Skill contract adds a conditional evidence protocol while preserving previous use when no aggregate-effect claim is made.

operational_budget.rationale: This package change does not alter a running service or establish an operational resource budget.

threat_boundary.rationale: The protocol requires hidden scorer blinding and records that native shared-worktree execution is weaker than container isolation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The package change is one Level 2 scope with tests, independent review, an evidence artifact, and an atomic commit planned after full verification.

release_recovery.rationale: The local Skill package has no deployable rollout, feature flag, or recovery operation.

data_migration.rationale: No production schema, persisted representation, or backfill changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No runtime configuration or secret is read, written, or recorded.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency or lockfile changes; pinned Git revisions are used only to preserve historical local evidence.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, reference protocol, template, manifests, review, and evidence retain the execution and claim-boundary knowledge.

reproducibility.rationale: The template, deterministic seed derivation, hashes, standard-library analyzer, and committed tests reproduce protocol validation without external services.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Standard-library parser, immutable-envelope validation, task-plan/order checks, clustered bootstrap, paired randomization, and scoped decision output.
Synthetic positive, null, inconclusive, malformed, clustered-repeat, immutable-envelope, and randomized-order tests.
Pre-registration, isolation, blind scoring, stopping, inference, interpretation, and retest procedure.
Fresh current-Skill forward-test result: 15/15 compound evidence checks with current Skill, scenario, scorer, and output hashes, explicitly bounded to protocol effectiveness.
Current-Skill input, scorer, and fixture hashes; allowed-input boundary; fresh read-only output; explicit preflight contract; and a non-effect claim boundary.
Fresh pre-rule transcript that fails the terminal calibration contract.
Fresh read-only transcript that incorrectly treats an in-memory probe as a root-cause fix; retained as a negative control.
Fresh current-Skill negative control that names a likely owner and an in-memory result but incorrectly ends with root-cause fix; retained to prove the preflight rule addressed a real failure.
Fresh post-rule read-only transcript with explicit authority/status/diff gate and exact unknown conclusion.
Standard-library terminal-label scorer for unrun, proposed, read-only, and in-memory-only counterfactual contracts.
V5/V7/V9 negative controls, V10 final-output and manifest-hash checks, and preflight terminal-calibration regressions.
Independent review findings, remediation, and approved final re-review for the frozen effect-evaluation and calibration package.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the effect-measurement policy, analyzer and stub, template, reference, README, causal-calibration contract and artifacts, forward-test artifacts, historical input-revision repair, tests, review, and this evidence artifact together. Existing Skill use remains compatible because the protocol is required only for aggregate-effect claims.

independent_review.notes: Independent final review approved evidence closure after hash/path checks and confirmation that no overall uplift claim is made without the registered 20-task paired hidden-repair experiment.

remaining_risks: No actual paired agent corpus has been collected, so this package change does not show a repair-success advantage or an overall model causal-capability improvement.
A completed result remains scoped to its registered model, Harness, Skill revision, corpus, and hidden scorer.
Native subagents are protocol-isolated only; strong causal claims require external worktree or container isolation and blind scoring.
